description: This PHP class 'Generator' is part of a documentation generation tool within the 'Todaymade\Daux\Format\HTML' namespace. It handles tasks such as generating static HTML pages from documentation source nodes, sanitizing HTML content, managing recursive directory traversal, and integrating with configuration and content types.

classes.name: Generator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating static HTML documentation pages from a directory tree of entries, handling content sanitization, recursion, and integration with configuration and content types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Generator with a Daux instance, setting up configuration and template renderer.

methods.name: getContentTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of content types supported, primarily markdown in this context.

methods.name: generateAll
methods.description: Performs the recursive generation of all documentation pages, including copying assets, copying source files, and building search index if enabled.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Removes HTML tags, scripts, styles, and other non-visible content, and collapses whitespace to produce plain text suitable for indexing.

methods.name: generateRecursive
methods.description: Recursively traverses the directory tree to generate HTML pages for each node, handling directories and files accordingly.

methods.name: generateOne
methods.description: Generates a single page from a documentation node, returning a RawPage, ComputedRawPage, or a content page based on node type.
